fixesApplied: CreateSession emitted the session immediately, while Airtop still reports status "initializing". The session is unusable until "running": CreateWindow and every page operation answer HTTP 404 before then. This passed the CLI test only because GetSession was run manually in between; in a real flow (create session -> open window) it failed every time. CreateSession now polls GET /sessions/{id} every 2 s until the session reports running, with a 120 s ceiling and a CancelError if the session ends first.

E2E flow test-flow-session-lifecycle.json filtered FindSessions on status "running" while the session was still initializing, so FindSessions took the notFound port. Its Assert never fired, AfterAll never completed, and TerminateSession never ran — leaking a billed session on every run. The status filter was removed so the lookup is deterministic.

Take Screenshot emitted the whole image as a base64 data URL. The broker CANCELS (does not retry) any message over BROKER_SERVER_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE_BYTES (2 MB default) and base64 inflates by a third, so a large screenshot could kill the message; nothing downstream could attach or upload it either. It now decodes the image and stores it with context.saveFileStream, emitting fileId/fileName/fileSize. The Format input was dropped - it only chose a transport that is now an internal detail.

Query Page blocked receive() for up to 300 s on Airtop's synchronous endpoint. Airtop also exposes POST /api/v1/async/sessions/{id}/windows/{id}/page-query (returns requestId) plus GET /api/v1/requests/{requestId}/status, so the component now submits and collects the answer through a context.setTimeout continuation at the engine's one-minute floor, with a 15-minute ceiling. Output schema and port are unchanged; a fast query now takes at least one minute. Its quota resource moved from browser-operations to requests - a submit-and-return component does not hold a concurrency slot.

CreateSession timeoutMinutes and TakeScreenshot maxWidth/maxHeight used a bare parseInt, so a non-numeric binding reached Airtop as null (serialized NaN). All numeric inputs now go through lib.parseIntegerInput with an explicit range.

MakeApiCall silently dropped Query Parameters / Request Headers whose bound value was not parseable, turning a filtered call into an unfiltered one that still reported success. It now throws a CancelError.

Live verification found three fields declared on outPorts that the API does not return: CreateWindow title/url (absent with waitUntil=load and waitUntil=complete alike - the create-window response carries only windowId and targetId) were removed; the Find Sessions listing turned out to be polymorphic by status, so cdpUrl/cdpWsUrl/chromedriverUrl/currentUsage stay declared but are now optional per level via `required` on the static schemas.
notes: INSTANCE ARTIFACT, not a connector defect: the first flow start after every publish fails with TokenError "Missing type property: apiKey | oauth | oauth2" (observed at 14:16 after the first publish and 14:24 after the republish). A re-run with no publish in between passes with 0 errors. Budget one throwaway run after publishing, or re-run before believing a NEEDS_FIX.
Airtop credit costs measured live: QueryPage 15, TypeText 27, ClickElement 485. ClickElement is by far the most expensive operation — keep it out of flows that run often.
The account is on a free plan: session listings report recordingState "free_plan_disabled", so the CreateSession `record` option cannot be exercised on this account.

The session-lifecycle Assert on FindSessions is weak — it asserts the whole result array is notEmpty, which stringifies to "[object Object],...". It passes, but a future revision should assert a specific field instead.
appmixer test component binds a FIXED port 2300; two component tests cannot run concurrently (EADDRINUSE).

Session listing vs. session detail return DIFFERENT records: GET /sessions omits the connection URLs for a session that has ended, while GET /sessions/{id} returns them for both running and ended sessions. `currentUsage` shows up only once a session has been running for a while - it is absent right after creation and on an ended session. Any assertion on those fields must account for status.

The Airtop async API is real and used by Query Page: POST /api/v1/async/sessions/{id}/windows/{wid}/page-query answers 201 with {requestId, errors, warnings} at the ROOT (no data envelope), and GET /api/v1/requests/{requestId}/status answers {status: pending|completed|error, response} where `response` is the full AI envelope (data.modelResponse + meta.status/usage). Measured: query completed in ~5 s, delivered by the continuation at the engine's 60 s floor.

appmixer connector verify cannot express `required` for a dynamic (source) outPort - it reads the generateOutputPortOptions list and treats every option as required. Find Sessions therefore reports a FAIL whenever it samples an ended session. Fixing that belongs in appmixer-cli (connector-verify/index.js, declaredFields() hardcodes required: null for the options form), not in the connector.

Publishing after this round needed remove + publish of ALL TEN components, not a plain publish: lib.js changed and every component requires it, and `appmixer publish` never refreshes an existing (component, version) snapshot. Verified afterwards that each stored component zip holds exactly one copy of its behavior and carries the new markers (async/sessions, saveFileStream, ITEM_SCHEMA, parseIntegerInput). The TokenError-on-first-start artifact did not appear this time.
